text_en: Then Jacob went on his journey, and came to the land of the people of the east.
text_cn: 雅各伯取道前行，来到了东方人的地方；

text_en: As he looked, he saw a well in the field and three flocks of sheep lying there beside it; for out of that well the flocks were watered. The stone on the well’s mouth was large,
text_cn: 举目看见田间有口井，还有三群羊，卧在井旁。──因为人惯常由这井取水饮羊，井口上盖着块大石头；

text_en: and when all the flocks were gathered there, the shepherds would roll the stone from the mouth of the well, and water the sheep, and put the stone back in its place on the mouth of the well.
text_cn: 几时羊群都聚集在那里，人就将井口的石头挪开，取水饮羊；然后再将石头盖在井口原处。

text_en: Jacob said to them, “My brothers, where do you come from? ” They said, “We are from Haran. ”
text_cn: 雅各伯对他们说：“弟兄们，你们是哪里的？”他们答说：“我们是哈兰人。”

text_en: He said to them, “Do you know Laban son of Nahor? ” They said, “We do. ”
text_cn: 雅各伯问他们说：“你们认识纳曷尔的儿子拉班吗？”他们答说：“我们认识。”

text_en: He said to them, “Is it well with him? ” “Yes, ” they replied, “and here is his daughter Rachel, coming with the sheep. ”
text_cn: 雅各伯又问说：“他好吗？”他们答说：“他好。看，那不是他的女儿辣黑耳领着羊群来了。”

text_en: He said, “Look, it is still broad daylight; it is not time for the animals to be gathered together. Water the sheep, and go, pasture them. ”
text_cn: 雅各伯说：“看，太阳还很高，尚不到聚集家畜的时候，你们取水饮了羊，然后再领去牧放。”

text_en: But they said, “We cannot until all the flocks are gathered together, and the stone is rolled from the mouth of the well; then we water the sheep. ”
text_cn: 他们回答说：“不能够；因为除非等所有羊群都聚集起来，才可挪开井口的石头，取水饮羊。”

text_en: While he was still speaking with them, Rachel came with her father’s sheep; for she kept them.
text_cn: 他还同他们说话的时候，辣黑耳领着他父亲的羊群到了；因为她是个牧羊女。

text_en: Now when Jacob saw Rachel, the daughter of his mother’s brother Laban, and the sheep of his mother’s brother Laban, Jacob went up and rolled the stone from the well’s mouth, and watered the flock of his mother’s brother Laban.
text_cn: 雅各伯一见了舅父拉班的女儿辣黑耳，和舅父拉班的羊群，就上前去，挪开井口的石头，取水饮他舅父拉班的羊。

text_en: Then Jacob kissed Rachel, and wept aloud.
text_cn: 然后雅各伯口亲辣黑耳，放声大哭，

text_en: And Jacob told Rachel that he was her father’s kinsman, and that he was Rebekah’s son; and she ran and told her father.
text_cn: 告诉辣黑耳，自己是她父亲的外甥，黎贝加的儿子。辣黑耳便跑回去，告诉她父亲。

text_en: When Laban heard the news about his sister’s son Jacob, he ran to meet him; he embraced him and kissed him, and brought him to his house. Jacob told Laban all these things,
text_cn: 拉班一听得了关于他外甥雅各伯的消息，就跑来迎接他，抱住他，亲他，领他到自己的家中。雅各伯遂将所遇的事全告诉了拉班。

text_en: and Laban said to him, “Surely you are my bone and my flesh! ” And he stayed with him a month.
text_cn: 拉班对他说：“你实在是我的骨肉。”雅各伯遂同他住下了。

text_en: Then Laban said to Jacob, “Because you are my kinsman, should you therefore serve me for nothing? Tell me, what shall your wages be? ”
text_cn: 过了一月，拉班对雅各伯说：“岂可因为你是我的外甥，就该白白服事我？告诉我，你要什么报酬？”

text_en: Now Laban had two daughters; the name of the elder was Leah, and the name of the younger was Rachel.
text_cn: 拉班有两个女儿：大的名叫肋阿，小的名叫辣黑耳。

text_en: Leah’s eyes were lovely, and Rachel was graceful and beautiful.
text_cn: 肋阿双眼无神；辣黑耳却相貌美丽；

text_en: Jacob loved Rachel; so he said, “I will serve you seven years for your younger daughter Rachel. ”
text_cn: 为此雅各伯喜爱辣黑耳，遂回答说：“我愿为你小女儿辣黑耳服事你七年。”

text_en: Laban said, “It is better that I give her to you than that I should give her to any other man; stay with me. ”
text_cn: 拉班答说：“我将她给你，比给外人好；你就同我住下。”

text_en: So Jacob served seven years for Rachel, and they seemed to him but a few days because of the love he had for her.
text_cn: 这样，雅各伯为得到辣黑耳，服事了拉班七年；由于他喜爱这少女，看七年好像几天。

text_en: Then Jacob said to Laban, “Give me my wife that I may go in to her, for my time is completed. ”
text_cn: 雅各伯遂对拉班说：“期限已满，请将我的妻子给我，我好与她亲近。”

text_en: So Laban gathered together all the people of the place, and made a feast.
text_cn: 拉班也请了当地所有的人士，摆了婚宴。

text_en: But in the evening he took his daughter Leah and brought her to Jacob; and he went in to her.
text_cn: 到了晚上，他却将自己的女儿肋阿，引到雅各伯前，雅各伯就亲近了她。──

text_en: (Laban gave his maid Zilpah to his daughter Leah to be her maid. )
text_cn: 拉班且将自己的婢女齐耳帕给了女儿肋阿作婢女。──

text_en: When morning came, it was Leah! And Jacob said to Laban, “What is this you have done to me? Did I not serve with you for Rachel? Why then have you deceived me? ”
text_cn: 到了早晨，他一见是肋阿，便对拉班说：“你对我作的是什么事？我服事你，岂不是为了辣黑耳？你为什么欺骗我？”

text_en: Laban said, “This is not done in our country—giving the younger before the firstborn.
text_cn: 拉班回答说：“我们这地方没有先嫁幼女，而后嫁长女的风俗。

text_en: Complete the week of this one, and we will give you the other also in return for serving me another seven years. ”
text_cn: 你同长女满了七天以后，我也将幼女给你，只要你再服事我七年。”

text_en: Jacob did so, and completed her week; then Laban gave him his daughter Rachel as a wife.
text_cn: 雅各伯就这样做了。与肋阿满了七天以后，拉班便将自己的女儿辣黑耳给了他为妻。──

text_en: (Laban gave his maid Bilhah to his daughter Rachel to be her maid. )
text_cn: 拉班且将自己的婢女彼耳哈给了女儿辣黑耳作婢女。──

text_en: So Jacob went in to Rachel also, and he loved Rachel more than Leah. He served Laban for another seven years.
text_cn: 雅各伯也亲近了辣黑耳，而且他爱辣黑耳甚于肋阿；于是又服事了拉班七年。

text_en: When the Lord saw that Leah was unloved, he opened her womb; but Rachel was barren.
text_cn: 上主见肋阿失宠，便开了她的胎；但辣黑耳却荒胎不孕。

text_en: Leah conceived and bore a son, and she named him Reuben; for she said, “Because the Lord has looked on my affliction; surely now my husband will love me. ”
text_cn: 肋阿怀孕生了一子，给他起名叫勒乌本，说：“上主垂视了我的苦衷，现在我的丈夫会爱我了。”

text_en: She conceived again and bore a son, and said, “Because the Lord has heard that I am hated, he has given me this son also”; and she named him Simeon.
text_cn: 她又怀孕生了一子，说：“上主听说我失了宠，又给了我一个。”遂给他起名叫西默盎。

text_en: Again she conceived and bore a son, and said, “Now this time my husband will be joined to me, because I have borne him three sons”; therefore he was named Levi.
text_cn: 她又怀孕生了一子，说：“这次，我的丈夫可要恋住我了，因为我已给他生了三个儿子。”遂给他起名叫肋未。

text_en: She conceived again and bore a son, and said, “This time I will praise the Lord ”; therefore she named him Judah; then she ceased bearing.
text_cn: 她又怀孕生了一子，说：“这次我要赞颂上主。”为此给他起名叫犹大。以后就停止生育。
